data.one_liner: A configurable Dart logger for libraries and apps
data.what_it_does: quick_log provides a Logger class that can print to console, write to file, or send logs to a backend. It supports filtering by tags, log levels, and can be used in tests via a stream writer.
use_when: Need fine-grained control over library logs
Want to test log output in unit tests
Require cross-platform logging without external dependencies
avoid_when: You only need a simple console print and don’t care about filtering or test integration
strengths: Cross-platform support (android, ios, web, windows, macos, linux)
weaknesses: No built-in async or network transport
Limited to console/file/backend via custom writers
